# Research studies

<!-- Generated by tools/research/research.py render (tools/research/indexes.py). Edit the studies, not this page. -->

This directory holds research development and its supporting records: arguments in progress, critique, integration evidence and reviews. Current integrated formulations live in [theories](../../theories/becoming/README.md); executable experiments live in [experiments](../../experiments/README.md); unmodified imported sources and provenance live in [sources](../../sources/README.md).

When continuing a study, edit its repository files directly and reuse the relevant study rather than starting a new dated workspace for the same work. Superseded material moves to a sibling `history/` folder with `research.py move`, which writes the manifest; the [repository working conventions](../../AGENTS.md) apply throughout.
